messages:
alex.k: quick q — where's the canonical TTFT + tokens/sec panels for private clusters? need to debug a cold-start spike on dedicated pool.

maya.p: try the Grafana "Latency & Tokenflow" dashboard — https://grafana.redwood.com/d/latflow/latency-tokenflow . Panels you want:
- TTFT p50 / p95 / p99 (by model)
- tokens/sec heatmap (by shard)
- request rate + active replicas

ryan: can you paste the PromQL for p95 TTFT split by model? want to wire into a panel.

maya.p: sure — rough queries we use:
```
# p95 TTFT by model
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))

# tokens/sec
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (model, shard)
```

sara: proposed alerting thresholds (starting point):
- TTFT p95 > 600ms for 5m -> severity=page
- tokens/sec drops > 50% vs 10m baseline for 3m -> severity=page
- p99 > 1200ms -> severity=alarm (investigate fallback)

ryan: +1 but for interactive/prod-critical models use p95 > 350ms as page, since users notice smaller slips. Also consider an adaptive threshold (3x median).

alex.k: where do I edit these alerts? Grafana alerting or prometheus Alertmanager rules?

maya.p: infra keeps long-running infra rules in repo: https://git.redwood.com/infra/observability/tree/main/alerts . Grafana alerts are for product dashboards / demos.

maya.p: alert rule snippet we use (infra/observability/alerts/ttft-rules.yaml):
```
- alert: TTFT_P95_High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(ttft_bucket[5m]))) > 0.6
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "TTFT p95 high for {{ $labels.model }}"
    description: "p95 TTFT > 600ms for {{ $labels.model }}"
```

alex.k: traces — is there a jump link from Grafana panels to Jaeger/Tempo? need a sample trace for a cold-start spike.

maya.p: yes — panels have "View trace" (links to Jaeger). If you click panel -> open -> on the histogram there's a link that adds ?service=runtime&traceid={{trace}} . Template:
https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=runtime&traceID={{trace}}

sara: quick debugging checklist:
- check TTFT p95 spike on model panel
- check tokens/sec heatmap for shard imbalance
- open sample trace -> look for long decoder init or kvcache misses
- check node allocation / scaling events in metrics

ryan: for long-term, we should add a tokens/sec per-replica panel (rate normalized by replicas) — I can open a PR.

alex.k: noted. i'll run through this and post findings. thanks!
